english: Let $E$ be the locus of the complex numbers $z$ satisfying $10|z-1|=3|z+\bar{z}-34|$. Then the ratio of the length of the minor axis of $E$ to the length of its major axis is ______.
hindi: माना कि $E$ उन सम्मिश्र संख्याओं $z$ का बिन्दुपथ है जो $10|z-1|=3|z+\bar{z}-34|$ को संतुष्ट करती हैं। तब $E$ के लघु अक्ष की लम्बाई तथा उसके दीर्घ अक्ष की लम्बाई का अनुपात ______ है।
solution: Distance from the focus $1$ $=\dfrac{3}{5}\times$ distance from the line $x=17$: an ellipse with $e=\dfrac{3}{5}$ (not $\dfrac{3}{10}$)
solution_full: For $z=x+iy$, $z+\bar{z}=2x$, so $|z+\bar{z}-34|=2|x-17|$, and the condition is $|z-1|=\dfrac{3}{10}\cdot2|x-17|=\dfrac{3}{5}|x-17|$.

$|z-1|$ is the distance of $z$ from the point $S=(1,0)$ and $|x-17|$ is its distance from the line $x=17$. So $E$ is the conic with focus $S$, directrix $x=17$ and eccentricity $e=\dfrac{3}{5}<1$: an ellipse. (Reading $e$ as $\dfrac{3}{10}$ is the trap.)
So $a=15$, $b=12$, and $e=\sqrt{1-\dfrac{144}{225}}=\dfrac{3}{5}$, consistent with the focus-directrix form (centre $-8$, focus $-8+ae=1$, directrix $-8+\dfrac{a}{e}=17$).
Ratio of the minor axis to the major axis $=\dfrac{2b}{2a}=\dfrac{12}{15}=0.8$.
originality_note: New: the directrix is hidden in the conjugate expression |z + zbar - 34|, so the eccentricity is twice the visible coefficient (way 4). Closest known: |z - a| + |z - b| = 2a ellipse loci; focus-directrix definition. Different because: the conic is given through z + zbar = 2 Re z, and the factor 2 decides e; a light question, flagged as standard ingredients.
blueprint_concepts: Ellipse and hyperbola loci in complex form

concept_use.Ellipse and hyperbola loci in complex fo: The locus is identified as an ellipse (e < 1) and its axes a = 15, b = 12 are found.
concept_use.Conic section in complex numbers: |z - 1| = (3/5)|x - 17| is read as the focus-directrix definition of a conic with e = 3/5, using z + zbar = 2x.

key_step: Convert |z + zbar - 34| to 2|x - 17| so the condition is PS = (3/5) PM; then b/a = sqrt(1 - e^2).
justification: A short routine chain with one trap (the factor 2 in z + zbar); level 2, comparable to 2026-P2-Q17 (L2).
